title: video-vbvr re-registers dests (width/height/seed/prompt) already set by video-generate with different defaults
detail: add_vbvr_args() re-adds 16-18 dests on the shared parser; first-writer-wins overrides video-generate defaults. Drop duplicates or use conflict_handler.

title: sys.exit(1) in library/context-manager code prevents caller recovery
detail: require_file/resolve_lora_path/GpuLock/run_session call sys.exit from non-entry modules. Raise exceptions instead; exit only in run.py entry point.

title: subprocess.run/Popen calls lack timeout, returncode, and FileNotFoundError handling
detail: video-compare/relay/check-model/audio_noise_detect subprocess calls omit timeout= and binary-existence checks. video-relay._extract_last_frame is a recurring hotspot (ffmpeg first subprocess.run with no FileNotFoundError/timeout guard, run 2026-06-20). Add timeout and verify binary exists first.

title: sys.path.insert(0,...) in library modules is unsafe across import contexts
detail: ltx_downloader.py (library) and run.py mutate sys.path. Fragile in library code imported as app.ltx_downloader. Insert in run.py only and dedup entries.

title: Bare dict/list fields in dataclasses give no static checking
detail: RunConfig.ab_params, Manifest, GenerationResult.events use bare dict/list. Parameterize as dict[str, Any] / list[dict[str, str]] for static checking.

title: image-purify --purify-mode uses dest='mode' colliding with faceswap --mode
detail: Shared image parser: purify's dest='mode' collides with faceswap --mode. Give purify a unique dest (purify_mode). Recurred 3 runs after a fix regressed.

title: image-angle --input registers dest='input' diverging from _shared dest='input_image'
detail: _shared.py registers --input with dest=input_image but image-angle pre-registers dest=input. Normalize all --input flags to dest=input_image everywhere. Confirmed AGAIN in run 2026-06-20T04-30-59 (image-angle.py:27) — the reviewer still proposes this; it was rejected this run as a known/intended divergence but the divergence itself remains live, so the pattern persists and keeps recurring as a rejections-class finding.

title: Module-body importlib eagerly loads all sub-actions at import time
detail: image.py (14) and video.py (8) call importlib.import_module at module body, forcing full load during --help/schema. Defer into run()/build_parser lazily.

title: Dead code after return statement in ZImagePipeline.generate()
detail: pipeline.py has unreachable code after a return in generate(). Most unstable file — fix recurred 5x after 2 applies. Re-verify after every pipeline.py edit.

title: Comparing args.X to a float/int literal to detect override is broken (sentinel bug)
detail: FLF2V cfg_scale auto-override compares ==5.0 but can't distinguish explicit 5.0 from default. Use default=None sentinel and check if args.x is None.

title: lora_scale/strength `val or default` pattern silently overrides scale=0.0
detail: `val or default` is falsy when val=0.0, silently reverting to default. Use `if val is None: val = default` (image-faceswap, image-expansion, image-i2i seed).

title: sys.exit()/SystemExit inside an A/B variation loop aborts the whole batch
detail: Audio-noise check (check_audio_noise_or_exit) calls sys.exit within the variation loop, killing all remaining variants. Catch SystemExit or continue instead.

title: Ternary expression used as a statement in void context does nothing
detail: video-relay audio mux error path: `x if cond else y` as a bare line executes but the result is discarded — shutil.move not reliably called. Rewrite as if/else. Confirmed again in run 2026-06-19T22-02-33 (video-relay.py:536).

title: --count N without --seed-start produces N identical images that overwrite each other
detail: run.py --count N alone returns [seed]*count (N identical images overwriting _s{seed}.png). Pair --count with --seed-start for real best-of-N variance.

title: _adjust_frames lets --frames 1 (and aligned values <9) pass through unchanged
detail: The 9-frame min clamp is inconsistent; the rounding branch can return a sub-minimum, yielding a degenerate single-frame video. Specifically _adjust_frames returns frames=1 unchanged when (frames-1)%8==0, bypassing the 9-frame minimum. Enforce min=9 before return. Confirmed again in run 2026-06-19T22-02-33 (video-vbvr.py:199).

title: Relay final-video manifest records frames=frames*n, overcounting by inter-segment overlap
detail: Relay segments overlap but the manifest sums raw frames, overcounting. Record actual concatenated frame count after overlap removal.

title: Image.open() / open().read() without context manager leaks fd across batch loop
detail: execute_generation/_fit_to_image/_resolve_text_prompt/SeedVR2 upscale open files without `with`. Use context managers to avoid fd leaks across long batch runs.

title: getattr(obj,'attr') without default raises AttributeError in hot paths
detail: lora_utils.set_module_by_name (lines 148/150) and video-generate getattr(args,prompt_key) omit defaults. Pass a default or guard with hasattr.

title: Bare except / except Exception: pass swallows all errors including BaseException
detail: pipeline.py chat_template, lora_utils.get_module_by_name, _shared upscaler.unload() bare-except hides KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit. Narrow to specific types.

title: convert.py imports mlx.nn twice as both nn and _nn (redundant alias)
detail: Redundant duplicate alias of mlx.nn. Consolidate to a single import. Recurred 3 times after fix — likely reintroduced via vendor-patch re-export or merge.

title: BooleanOptionalAction misuse generates bogus doubled --no-no- prefixes
detail: image-profile.py generates --no-no-vlm / --no-no-chain-ref. BooleanOptionalAction doubles the no- prefix when the flag name already contains 'no'.

title: refine registers required --input-image but add_common_generation_args also registers --input (same dest)
detail: Two flags target the same dest (input_image); the required=True constraint on --input-image can never be satisfied by the --input alias. Drop one registration so required is enforceable. Confirmed again in run 2026-06-19T22-02-33 (refine.py:29, surfaced twice as both correctness and argparse-integrity).

title: animate.py implements the command-module contract but is NOT in COMMAND_NAMES — dead code
detail: animate.py has PARSER_META/add_args/run but is never registered, masquerading as an active command. Register it in COMMAND_NAMES or delete the module. Confirmed again in run 2026-06-20T04-30-59 (animate.py:50) — still unregistered, still flagged. Confirmed AGAIN run 2026-06-21T00-11-24 (animate.py) — flagged twice in one run (orphan module + unreachable), still unregistered; the recurring nature makes this a stable reviewer signature, not a regression.

title: Relay generate() omits teacache_thresh and audio args, silently disabling features
detail: Relay generate() drops teacache_thresh (disabling TeaCache) and never passes audio args (model audio never generated). Pass through all intended args. Recurred run 2026-06-21T00-11-24: relay pipeline.generate() also omits audio_stage1_only, audio_cfg_scale, modality_scale, audio_path, audio_volume — the arg-drop surface is wider than first recorded; the relay->generate boundary is a recurring arg-passing hotspot.

title: RunConfig.argv snapshot uses sys.argv[1:], making naive replay inherit --force/--skip-gpu-lock
detail: The argv snapshot includes force/bypass flags, so replay re-runs with GPU-lock bypass unintentionally. Strip force/skip-gpu-lock from the stored argv.

title: Dict literal with duplicate keys silently keeps only the last definition
detail: _STYLE_PROMPTS dict defines video_score and video_analysis 3x each — earlier definitions are silently dead. Deduplicate dict keys; Python gives no warning.

title: build_parser importlib only catches ImportError, hiding real module-load bugs
detail: build_parser importlib only catches ImportError, silently skipping command modules and masking real sub-action bugs. Log the failing module for diagnosis.

title: load_image_rgb() Image.open() without corrupt-file handling — intentional raw-propagation contract
detail: REJECTED: raw PIL exception propagation is the documented contract; callers handle corrupt/missing files. Suppress this finding — it is not a bug.

title: _run_with_gpu_guard no top-level exception handler — intended CLI debugging behavior
detail: REJECTED: raw tracebacks with exit code 1 are the intended CLI behavior for debugging. Suppress — not a bug.

title: ZImagePipeline.generate() no MemoryError handling — conceptually accurate but lacks try/except at the right site
detail: REJECTED: conceptually accurate but generate() has no try/except around transformer creation where it would matter. Suppress — not actionable.

title: Adversarial verifier rejects ~51% of proposed findings (79 of 155 verdicts)
detail: Across 6 runs with adversarial verification, 79 of 155 verdicts were rejected (~51% rejection rate). The verifier is the primary quality gate.

title: Per-dimension findings/run: import-hygiene 15.7, type-safety 12.9, error-handling 5.5, correctness 3.9, argparse 3.7
detail: import-hygiene (15.7/run) and type-safety (12.9) are noisiest; correctness (3.9) and argparse (3.7) are lowest-volume but 0% FP — highest-impact.

title: pipeline.py is the most unstable file — fixes recurred in 5+ runs (dead code, bare except)
detail: pipeline.py findings (dead-code, bare-except) applied 2x each but recurred in 3+ later runs. Apply pipeline.py fixes last and re-verify; regression-prone.

title: Focus-mode runs (single dimension) surface 9-12 findings with 0% adversarial rejection in 8 of 10
detail: Single-dimension focus runs surface 9-12 verified findings but most run review-only without adversarial verification, so their FP rate is unmeasured.

title: 2026-06-13T01-05-42: largest run applied 60 fixes from 123 findings (62 verified) after 124 adversarial verdicts
detail: Largest auto-fix run: 123 findings -> 62 verified -> 60 applied, 0 regressions, restore not triggered. Fix tier works at scale when the tree is clean.

title: resolve_lora_path() / pipeline.generate() receive args.lora_path as a LIST (action="append") but expect a string — crashes with TypeError whenever --lora-path is set
detail: args.lora_path is registered with action="append" (multi-LoRA support), so it is always a list. Several command call sites pass args.lora_path straight into resolve_lora_path() (scalar string expected) or pipeline.generate(lora_path=...), crashing the moment a user sets --lora-path. Run 2026-06-18: image-controlnet.py:437/190, image-expansion.py:323, image-profile.py:777, image-workflow.py:876. Run 2026-06-19: image-profile.py:701 (profile passes args.lora_path list directly to pipeline.generate). Fix shape: index the list (args.lora_path[0] or iterate) or make resolve_lora_path accept a list.

title: Unguarded default=None on a flag silently wins over _shared's intended concrete default (e.g. default=777) on the unified image parser
detail: image-profile.py registers --seed with default=None but does NOT guard it, so the None silently overrides the _shared default=777 on the unified image parser. This is the same sentinel-pattern bug family already documented in MEMORY (argparse-sentinel-for-user-override): a per-command flag without a guard (default=None treated as 'unset') collides with the shared parser's concrete default. Here it manifests as the shared default being shadowed rather than as a magic-number override, but the root cause — missing guard so the per-command registration participates in arg resolution — is identical. Confirmed AGAIN run 2026-06-21T00-11-24 (image-profile.py, high severity): profile --seed default=None still poisons --seed for ALL image sub-actions on the unified parser. The fact that it keeps being flagged at HIGH severity and was independently recorded in MEMORY (argparse-sentinel-for-user-override) marks it as one of the most durable bug-families in this codebase.

title: Subcommand registers shared flags WITHOUT guards, relying on _shared's LATER skip to dedupe — order-coupled and fragile; stale comments compound it
detail: video-generate.py:192 declares --lora-path/--lora-scale/--prompt/--seed unguarded and depends on _shared.add_common_generation_args() skipping already-registered flags when it runs afterward. Correctness hinges entirely on registration ORDER (subcommand before _shared) and on _shared's skip logic being present. If _shared ever runs first, or its skip is removed/changed, these become argparse 'conflicting option' errors or silent double-registration. Run 2026-06-19 re-surfaced two facets: image.py:289 duplicate shared flags (--film-grain/--sharpening/--seed/--output) rely on registration ORDER not guards (medium), and video.py:113 stale comment claims --self-test is registered by add_common_generation_args() which video.py never calls (low). Run 2026-06-21 re-surfaced a third facet: image-workflow.py registers --film-grain / --sharpening without a guard, so purify's guarded copies of the same flags are silently skipped (help-text divergence between the two registrations). This is an architectural smell, not always a live crash today.

title: Help text advertises a default that differs from the actual argparse default — misleading --help, no runtime bug
detail: image-anime2real.py:156: --realism-style help string claims '3d-game (default)' but the actual argparse default is civitai-chinese. Pure documentation drift — help text was not updated when the default changed. No runtime impact, but erodes trust in --help and the schema-defaults reflection. Confirmed again in run 2026-06-19T22-02-33. Low severity; grep for '(default)' in help strings when a default is intentionally changed. Run 2026-06-21 re-surfaced a sibling: image-t2i.py help text advertises default 640/960 but the argparse default is None (sentinel) — same docs-vs-argparse-default drift class, only the dimensions differ.

title: Reshape/downsample expressions that assume dims are exact multiples of the latent grid, hidden behind an obfuscated one-liner
detail: flux2_outpaint_pipeline.py:330: mask downsample reshape assumes spatial dims are exact multiples of the latent grid, but the expression is written as an obfuscated one-liner that hides the divisibility assumption. If a caller passes dims that are NOT clean multiples (e.g. odd outpaint targets), the reshape silently produces wrong-shaped tensors or crashes with a cryptic error. Refactor to an explicit assert or floor-div with a comment stating the invariant. Low severity because current call paths happen to satisfy it; latent trap for future callers.

title: args.lora_scale is a LIST (multi-LoRA action=append) but call sites pass it as a scalar lora_scale — nested list / dataclass field violation
detail: With multi-LoRA support, args.lora_scale is registered with action="append" so it is always a list. Several command call sites pass the whole list where a scalar float is expected, producing a nested list or a dataclass type violation. Confirmed in run 2026-06-19T22-02-33 across THREE files: image-faceswap.py:438 wraps args.lora_scale (list) into lora_scales=[lora_scale] → nested list lora_scales=[[...]] passed to Flux2KleinPipeline; image-expansion.py:325 assigns whole args.lora_scale list to scalar lora_scale; image-workflow.py:877 builds RunConfig with lora_scale as a list, violating the float dataclass field. Sibling family to correctness:lora-path-list-vs-string-resolve (same root cause: multi-LoRA list not unwrapped at call sites). Fix shape: index the list or have pipelines accept a list consistently.

title: review-optimize scan coverage: full-scope scans reach 26-41 files; correctness + argparse-integrity are the live dimensions, multi-LoRA list-unwrapping is the dominant hotspot family
detail: Run 2026-06-18T14-11-24 (review-only, full scope): 26 files / 22165 lines across layers entry(1)+commands(18)+core(8); 10 findings all verified/new; correctness=7, argparse-integrity=3; critical=5 (ALL the lora-path list-vs-string bug family); hotspot image-controlnet.py=2, image-profile.py=2. Run 2026-06-19T22-02-33 (review-only, full scope): 41 files / 30122 lines across entry(1)+commands(40); 13 findings all verified/new (0 suppressed from prior); byDimension correctness=6 + argparse-integrity=7; severity high=5, medium=4, low=4; adversarial 0 verdicts (review-only, no prior to challenge); fixes review-only 0 applied. Run 2026-06-20T04-30-59 (review-only, full scope): 37 files / 29862 lines across entry(2)+commands(35); 7 findings (6 verified, 6 filtered); byDimension correctness=1 + argparse-integrity=3 + error-handling=2; severity high=1, medium=3, low=2; 1 rejected (image-angle dest divergence, recurs as rejection); fixes review-only 0 applied. Run 2026-06-21T00-11-24 (review-only, full scope): 40 files / 31601 lines across entry(2)+commands(40); 9 findings all verified/new/filtered (0 suppressed from prior); byDimension error-handling=1 + correctness=2 + argparse-integrity=6; severity high=1, medium=3, low=5; adversarial 0 verdicts (review-only); fixes review-only 0 applied. The multi-LoRA list-not-unwrapped family (lora_path AND lora_scale) remains the #1 hotspot family historically; this run's dominant dimension shifted to argparse-integrity (6/9) — the unified-parser shared-flag registration smells (default=None sentinel, order-coupled skip, dead registration) are the persistent argparse hotspot. The animate.py orphan module keeps being flagged (now 6 occurrences).

title: A flag registered to argparse is hardcoded False/True at the call site, so passing it is a silent no-op
detail: video-relay.py:1121 (run 2026-06-20): --temporal-upscale is accepted by the parser but the relay generate path passes temporal_upscale=False unconditionally, so --temporal-upscale on the CLI does nothing — the feature appears configurable but is permanently disabled. This is the argparse-contract-vs-implementation gap: the parser advertises a knob the code never honors. Fix shape: wire args.temporal_upscale through to the call site, or remove the flag to stop advertising dead functionality. High severity because users set the flag expecting an effect.

title: A concrete default on a per-subcommand flag wins for ALL sibling sub-actions on the unified image parser (first-writer-wins poisoning)
detail: image-purify.py:85 (run 2026-06-20): --seed is registered with default=42 inside purify's add_args, but because image uses a unified parser, that concrete default wins for EVERY image sub-action, overriding the intended t2i default seed=777. Distinct from the default=None sentinel family (argparse-integrity:unguarded-default-none-overrides-shared): there the per-command flag lacks a guard; here the per-command flag sets a CONCRETE default that leaks across sub-actions. Root cause: unified parser + per-submodule add_args means any concrete default a submodule sets becomes global to the parser. Fix shape: register shared flags once in _shared with the canonical default, and have submodules skip (or use default=None + guard) rather than re-declaring with a concrete value.

title: OpenCV VideoCapture / native handles opened without try/finally leak the handle if later code raises
detail: cv2.VideoCapture() (and VideoWriter) is opened and read, but cap.release() sits on the happy path with no try/finally — if any line between open and release raises, the capture handle is never released (fd/camera lock leaks, and on some backends the file stays locked). Same resource-lifetime class as mlx-review:image-open-without-context-manager but for OpenCV native handles rather than PIL files. Fix shape: wrap in try/finally (or contextlib.ExitStack) so release always runs. Hotspots across runs: video-segment.py (cap.get), video-restore.py (VideoCapture + VideoWriter, run 2026-06-21T00-11-24 medium).

title: add_review_args registers --output unguarded, conflicting with purify/other --output registrations (first-writer-wins)
detail: image-review.py:134 (run 2026-06-20): add_review_args() registers --output without checking whether it is already registered, creating a semantic conflict with image-purify's --output (and any other submodule --output) on the unified image parser. First-writer-wins means whichever submodule loads first owns the --output dest. Same architectural smell as mlx-review:vbvr-duplicate-dest-registrations and mlx-review:purify-mode-dest-collision: shared dest names registered without coordination. Fix shape: centralize --output (and other shared dests) in _shared with one canonical registration, or use add_argument with conflict_handler='resolve' deliberately.

title: image.py calls _restore.add_restore_args but 'restore' is not a documented image sub-action (dead registration)
detail: image.py invokes _restore.add_restore_args to register restore flags, but 'restore' is not listed as an image sub-action in COMMAND_NAMES / the image dispatcher, so the registration is dead — the flags are parsed but never routed to a handler. Same dead-registration family as mlx-review:animate-dead-code-command (orphan command module) but here the module IS reachable while the action wiring is not. Fix shape: either document 'restore' as an image sub-action and route it, or drop the add_restore_args call to stop advertising unreachable flags. Run 2026-06-21T00-11-24 (image.py:281, low).
